title: PTSD Screening in Pregnant Black Women
official: Comparing Two Screening Approaches for PTSD to Improve Health Outcomes in Pregnant Black Women
summary: This study will compare the effectiveness of two active screening interventions in improving post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms, maternal perinatal care utilization, satisfaction utilization of mental healthcare services, and maternal health and birth-related outcomes for Black pregnant women.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18+ years old,
* Ability to provide informed consent,
* English-speaking,
* Willingness to participate in the study,
* Self-identification as Black or African American,
* Pregnant and in the first trimester attending initial prenatal care visit,
* Endorsement of at least one traumatic event in their lifetime.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active suicidality
